AuctionClassification.description: Observed source category label of one auction revision; a display fact, not a code or a join key.

AuctionId.description: Canonical positive decimal text for an auction ID stored as a PostgreSQL signed bigint; maximum 9223372036854775807. 9223372036854775808 is rejected.

AuctionItemAtom.description: One of the eight eaT item label atoms; the code and the observed label are the same text.

AuctionLocation.description: Observed announcement-region codes of one auction revision in the source region scheme.

AuctionOrganization.description: Purchasing organization of one auction revision; id is the only identity.

AuctionParticipation.description: Observed list-side participant count (BID_CNT) of one auction attempt: latest observation and the newest one at least a day older.

AuctionPricing.description: Exact observed auction amounts with currency attached to each value.

AuctionProvenance.description: Traceability from a public auction revision to immutable source evidence and normalization.

AuctionSchedule.description: UTC lifecycle instants; null means that instant is not yet observed or not supplied.

AuctionTerms.description: Observed award terms of one auction revision: floor rate on the assessment-rate axis and the award-method code.

BaseRelativeBidRate.description: A bid rate measured against the base amount on a 100-point scale with exactly four fractional digits, matching numeric(9,4) mart columns.

BaseRelativeBidRateText.description: Bid-rate percentage-points text measured against the base amount with exactly four fractional digits and at most five integer digits, matching numeric(9,4) mart columns.

BidRate.description: A bid rate expressed on a 100-point scale with exactly three fractional digits, matching numeric(6,3) mart columns.

BidRateText.description: Canonical bid-rate percentage-points text with exactly three fractional digits, matching numeric(6,3) mart columns; from 0.000 through 100.000.

BusinessNumberText.description: Canonical ten-digit Korean business registration number text used only as a lookup key.

CanonicalMoneyAmount.description: Canonical nonnegative KRW amount with exactly two fractional digits.

CodeReference.description: A public reference to one core code value: numeric identity plus its scheme, code text and optional observed label.

CodeScheme.description: Source-scoped scheme identifier; schemes are never compared implicitly.

ContentSha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of immutable source content.

EligibilityArea.description: One eaT participation-restriction area code reference with its scheme, code text and optional observed label.

EligibilityAreaGroup.description: One eaT participation-restriction sido group: its whole-sido code and the sigungu codes observed under it.

ExternalBidId.description: Opaque source-scoped auction identifier; never parsed for identity.

InstantText.description: Canonical UTC ISO 8601 instant text ending in Z with at most nanosecond precision.

KstDateText.description: Canonical KST calendar date text as YYYY-MM-DD; the day boundary is Asia/Seoul.

KstMonthText.description: Canonical KST calendar month text as YYYY-MM; the month boundary is Asia/Seoul.

Latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees from -90 through 90.

LiveHealth.description: The server process can handle HTTP work.

Longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees from -180 through 180.

MartCoverage.description: Worst population coverage verdict across the requested cohort.

Money.description: Exact KRW money value; amount remains decimal text across JSON boundaries.

NonNegativeCount.description: Count of observed rows; JSON integer within PostgreSQL integer range.

ObservedBidRate.description: A source-computed bid rate on a 100-point scale with exactly three fractional digits; may exceed 100. The mart representation is decided where the mart column is owned.

ObservedBidRateText.description: Source-computed bid-rate percentage-points text with exactly three fractional digits and at most twelve integer digits, optionally negative; not capped at 100 because bids above the planned price are observed, and negative values are observed too.

OpenAuction.description: One open auction observed in mart.open_auction_snapshot with the round summary for its (organization, floor rate) cohort.

OrganizationAuctionAttempt.description: One auction attempt summarized from mart.org_round_summary.

PositiveBigintText.description: Canonical positive decimal text for a PostgreSQL signed bigint; maximum 9223372036854775807. 9223372036854775808 is rejected.

PublicAuctionIdentity.description: Public identity and display state for one canonical auction revision.

Ratio.description: A rate expressed on a 1.0 scale.

ReadyHealth.description: The server is accepting application work.

RegionCodeV1.description: One region code of an active government code release with its optional observed coordinate.

SourceCode.description: Opaque source code text that preserves leading zeroes.

SourceReleaseIdText.description: Canonical lowercase UUID text for a sealed ingest source release.

SourceSystem.description: Bounded identifier of the system that supplied an observation.

Wgs84Coordinate.description: Finite WGS84 coordinate with an explicit CRS.

WinRateDistributionBin.description: Half-open assessment-rate bin [from, to) and its win count.

WinRateDistributionBinBoundary.description: Half-open assessment-rate interval without a count.

WinRateDistributionModeRange.description: Contiguous interval around the modal bin with its share of the sample.

WinRateDistributionMonth.description: One KST month of the requested cohort.

WinRateDistributionPeriod.description: Inclusive KST month range the sample was counted over.

WorkspaceRegionPreference.description: The participation-restriction areas one workspace confirmed, with the instant of that confirmation.
